meta.title: Multiple suppliers invited at once with "Invite All Selected"

args.goal: On the displayed Vendor Finder results, select two or more vendor cards, click Invite All Selected at the bottom right, and stop when the screen confirms the invitation was successfully sent to all selected vendors.

steps.note: Performs the bulk selection and invitation flow while verifying the selected vendors are included in the successful invitation result.
Asserts that the invitation-sent confirmation is visible.
